name: Houston Chronicle editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides rates the Houston Chronicle Lean Left; its board calls itself nonpartisan and endorsed a mixed slate in 2026 (3 Republicans, 11 Democrats statewide).

name: Dallas Morning News editorial board
lean_basis: Historically center-right board that has recommended candidates of both parties; its 2026 statewide slate so far is 4 Republicans and 6 Democrats. AllSides rates the paper Center.

name: San Antonio Express-News editorial board
lean_basis: Hearst paper; AllSides rates it Lean Left. Its 2026 statewide slate is mostly Democrats with Republican picks on the courts and one no-recommendation.

name: Austin American-Statesman editorial board
lean_basis: Resumed candidate endorsements under Hearst ownership in 2026 after not endorsing in general elections since 2016 (Gannett era). Its statewide slate is 6 Democrats and 2 Republicans.

name: Fort Worth Star-Telegram editorial board
lean_basis: McClatchy paper; opinion section has a conservative editor and the board endorsed in both party primaries. No general-election statewide endorsements found as of Oct 16.

name: El Paso Times editorial board
lean_basis: Gannett paper. Gannett ended most candidate endorsements; the El Paso Times published a candidate questionnaire guide rather than recommendations in 2026.

name: The Texas Tribune
lean_basis: Nonprofit, nonpartisan newsroom. Does not endorse candidates or measures; publishes race guides and candidate Q&As.

name: The Austin Chronicle editorial board
lean_basis: Alt-weekly whose endorsements reflect its news staff and editors; endorsed the full Democratic statewide slate in 2026 and said so explicitly.

name: League of Women Voters of Texas
lean_basis: Nonpartisan 501(c)(3). Never supports or opposes candidates or parties; publishes candidate Q&As in its Voters Guide and on VOTE411.

name: Republican Party of Texas
lean_basis: Official state party organization.

name: Texas Democratic Party
lean_basis: Official state party organization.

name: Libertarian Party of Texas
lean_basis: Official state party; platform favors minimal government on both economic and personal issues.

name: Green Party of Texas
lean_basis: Official state party; platform centers ecology and social justice.

name: Texas AFL-CIO COPE
lean_basis: State labor federation; its 2026 general-election slate is entirely Democratic.

name: Texas State Teachers Association
lean_basis: NEA-affiliated teachers' union; 2026 endorsements are all Democrats.

name: Texas Association of Business (TXBIZ PAC)
lean_basis: State chamber of commerce PAC; describes endorsees as 'pro-business.' Announced general-election endorsements Oct 6, 2026; the public list page was empty when checked.

name: Texans for Lawsuit Reform PAC
lean_basis: Tort-reform PAC; 2026 primary endorsements were overwhelmingly Republican.

name: Texas Farm Bureau AGFUND
lean_basis: Farm Bureau PAC; endorses in both parties but its 2026 statewide endorsements were all Republicans.

name: Texas Parent PAC
lean_basis: Bipartisan public-education PAC that historically endorsed in both parties; in 2026 it endorsed only one candidate statewide (for governor).

name: NRA Political Victory Fund
lean_basis: National Rifle Association's PAC; grades and endorses on gun-rights record.

name: Texas State Rifle Association PAC
lean_basis: NRA state affiliate PAC.

name: Texas Right to Life PAC
lean_basis: Anti-abortion PAC; requires a survey and interview; 2026 endorsements are all Republicans.

name: Planned Parenthood Texas Votes
lean_basis: Abortion-rights advocacy PAC; 2026 endorsements are all Democrats.

name: Equality Texas Action
lean_basis: LGBTQ advocacy group's political arm; endorsements favor Democrats and out LGBTQ candidates.

name: Texas Values Action
lean_basis: Social-conservative advocacy group; 2026 endorsements are all Republicans.

name: Combined Law Enforcement Associations of Texas (CLEAT PAC)
lean_basis: Largest Texas police union PAC; endorses in both parties but mostly Republicans statewide.

name: Sierra Club Lone Star Chapter (Sierra Club Political Committee of Texas)
lean_basis: Environmental group's political arm; 2026 endorsements found are all Democrats.

name: Texas Freedom Network / Texas Rising Action
lean_basis: Progressive advocacy group; self-described.
